messages:
Sam Rivera: heads-up team 8 were seeing a surge of leads stuck in enrichment for 8-15m. HS -> SF SLA is hitting 40% misses this morning.
Nina Gomez: ack. any single enrichment vendor or source?
Owen Park: mostly third-party email lookups from VendorX + a batch of webinar signups. VendorX started returning 500s around 09:12PT.
Leah Kim: that explains it. can we short-circuit and still flow leads to Sales? We should avoid creating unassigned orphan leads.
Sam Rivera: proposal: if enrichment fails or exceeds 12s, set property `enrich_status=degraded` and run an HS workflow to map lead to SF owner via a reduced-info mapping (email->sf owner by territory) and tag `auto:enrich_fallback`.
Nina Gomez: +1. For Salesforce mapping, we already have an apex job that can accept partial records. Need to ensure required SF fields are present to avoid rejects. Owen, can enrichment emit a compact payload with minimal fields when degraded?
Owen Park: yes. I'll add an endpoint /compact-enrich that returns {first_name,last_name,email,geo_code,utm_source}. Code change will also emit metric `enrich.vendorx.500_rate` and timer `enrich.latency_ms`.
Leah Kim: also add a short-circuit rule in HubSpot: workflow triggers when `enrich_status=degraded` AND `lead_source IN (webinar, form)` -> assign to queue `Inbound - Triage` via round-robin.
Sam Rivera: two operational constraints: 1) don't flood SDRs during a vendor outage; implement a per-minute throttle of 25 auto-assigns. 2) add a cooldown on round-robin assignment for manual triage (15m).
Nina Gomez: HubSpot can do the throttle by checking a custom property `recent_auto_assigns_5m` that we increment via automation. I'll wire that into the workflow as `recent_auto_assigns_5m < 25`.
Owen Park: one caveat: when we short-circuit, we lose enriched firmographic data used by SF lead scoring. We should add an indicator `score_degraded=true` so downstream scoring job can fallback to logistic model that tolerates missing features.
Leah Kim: good call. I'll update the scoring playbook to treat score_degraded leads as "low-confidence" and add them to daily SDR morning queue if not contacted within 4 hours.
Sam Rivera: can we stage this? Plan: 1) opt-in canary for 5% of inbound -> short-circuit route 2) monitor `hs_to_sf.handoff_success` rate + SDR feedback for 24h 3) ramp to 100% if no major issues.
Nina Gomez: I can create a HubSpot list that filters 5% by country hash and toggle the workflow via list membership for canary. Also will add a Slack notification to #sdr-ops when canary toggles.
Owen Park: deploying compact-enrich to staging now. snippet for fallback path:
```
start = now();
resp = vendorx.lookup(email);
if (!resp.ok || (now()-start) > 12000) {
  emit('enrich.fallback', {reason: resp.code||'timeout'});
  return compactPayload(email);
}
return fullPayload(resp);
```
Leah Kim: flow changes checklist: update HS workflow, update SF mapping to accept compact payloads, update scoring job to respect score_degraded, throttles on auto-assigns, and create runbook entry `runbook/inbound-enrichment-fallback.md`.
Sam Rivera: assign owners: Owen -> compact-enrich + metrics, Nina -> HubSpot workflow + throttle property, Leah -> SF mapping + scoring update, Sam -> runbook + canary gating.
Nina Gomez: I'll also add an automated test: simulate 200 form leads with VendorX 500s, verify no more than 25 auto-assigns/min and that all leads get `auto:enrich_fallback` tag.
Owen Park: once staging looks good, I'll push to prod behind a feature flag `enrich_shortcircuit_v2`.
Leah Kim: quick question: should we set a max age after which degraded leads are re-queued for enrichment retry? maybe 24 hours?
Sam Rivera: yes — requeue for enrichment retry after 24h; mark `enrich_retry_count` and stop after 3 attempts. put that into the runbook.
Nina Gomez: updating HS workflow draft now. will post link to preview and the test plan.
Owen Park: staging run finished. rate-limit and tagging behaved as expected. opening PR: https://git.internal.redwood/enrichment/pulls/5127
Leah Kim: great. I'll reach out to SDR leads to prep them for the canary and share the assessment template.
Sam Rivera: thanks everyone. follow-ups: Nina to push HS workflow to canary list, Owen to merge behind flag, Leah to update scoring + SF mapping, Sam to publish runbook. reconvene 24h after canary to review SLA impact. :rocket:
